artifacts.name: cfd.mm.scores.cas9.txt
artifacts.note: Doench et al. 2016 (Nat Biotechnol 34:184-191, doi:10.1038/nbt.3437) CFD nucleotide-pair mismatch weights for SpCas9, 12 mismatch types x 20 positions = 240 entries. Redistributed as plain text by the Bioconductor package crisprScore (crisprVerse/crisprScore, inst/cfd_cas9/). Keys are {spacer_base}{protospacer_base}{position} in DNA space with NO reverse-complement (the revcomp of the original cfd_score_calculator.py is already absorbed); verified against the package's own published test vectors.

artifacts.name: cfd.pam.scores.cas9.txt
artifacts.note: CFD PAM weights for SpCas9, 16 dinucleotides keyed on the last 2 nt of the 3-nt PAM.

artifacts.name: mit.weights.txt
artifacts.note: Hsu 2013 MIT position weights (20). Downloaded as an independent cross-check: matched this repo's hardcoded HSU_WEIGHTS exactly.

note: REAL = downloaded + sha256-hashed with url/license/retrievedAt. Obtained as PLAIN TEXT deliberately: CRISPOR distributes the same matrix as a Python pickle, which is arbitrary code execution on load and was not used; coefficients were never reconstructed from memory. Validated on load against 7 published Cas9 test vectors (see grna/cfd_doench.py).
